name: Cisco
situation: Workforce planning across the enterprise ran on manual cycles that took days.
obstacle: The data sat behind HR and Finance APIs that an LLM could not be trusted to query directly.
decision: Built a LangGraph multi-agent system with a routing layer, so agents emit validated calls under least privilege and the platform executes them.
result: ~2M records in under five seconds, a multi-day cycle down to hours, and every action auditable. Deployed on OpenShift and Kubernetes.
visualAlt: Architecture diagram: a request is classified by a routing layer and dispatched to domain-specialised agents, which emit validated calls that the platform executes against approved Workday and Finance endpoints. The model sits outside the credential boundary.
